findings.current: I heightened my senses more sharply than ever and searched for signs of life inside. Only after I was certain that there were none did I start moving again.
findings.defect: The draft broadens 기척 into all signs of life, contradicting the fish and aquatic plants inside the passage. Taekyung is checking for a human presence or potential enemy.
findings.rationale: In context, 기척 refers to the presence Taekyung is guarding against, not every living organism in the passage.
findings.replacement: I sharpened my senses more than ever and searched the passage for any human presence. Only after I was certain there was none did I begin moving again.
findings.source: 어느 때보다 예리한 감각을 끌어올려 내부의 기척을 살핀 나는 확신이 들고 나서야 다시 이동을 시작했다.

findings.defect: “Haa” normally represents an exhalation, while 후읍 marks the sharp inhalation Taekyung takes upon surfacing.
findings.rationale: The following sentence explicitly describes damp air entering his lungs, confirming that this is an inhalation.

findings.current: *A torch? Well, night-shining pearls aren’t infinite.*
findings.defect: “Pearls aren’t infinite” is an unnatural literal rendering and obscures that the Dongting Fisherman has only a limited supply of the expensive pearls.
findings.rationale: The following explanation concerns the pearls’ cost and the need for torches to illuminate the entire cave.
findings.replacement: *A torch? Well, it’s not like he has an unlimited supply of night-shining pearls.*

findings.current: I was still far from possessing the insight to read the identity and origins of a martial art, but with my Supreme Peak cultivation, it was not difficult to infer what had happened from the traces left behind here and there.
findings.defect: “Read the identity” and “Supreme Peak cultivation” are stiff calques; the latter also replaces the source’s explicit statement that he has reached the Supreme Peak realm.
findings.rationale: The source contrasts his limited ability to identify martial arts with the observational ability conferred by his attained realm.
findings.replacement: I was still far from having the insight to discern the nature and roots of martial arts, but having reached the Supreme Peak realm, I had little trouble inferring what had happened from the traces left throughout the passage.
findings.source: 무공의 정체와 뿌리를 읽어 낼 만한 안목은 한참 부족하지만, 곳곳에 남긴 흔적을 통해 상황을 유추하는 것은 초절정의 경지에 도달한 내게 있어 그리 어려운 일이 아니다.

findings.current: If not, I would capture him and drag the larger body behind him into the light.
findings.defect: “The larger body behind him” is opaque and unnatural English for the more important figure Taekyung intends to draw out by capturing the Dongting Fisherman.
findings.rationale: 더 큰 몸통 figuratively denotes a larger or more important target, not a physically larger body.
findings.replacement: If not, I would capture him and use him to draw out the bigger player behind him.
findings.source: 그렇지 않다면 사로잡아 더 큰 몸통을 끌어내야 한다.

findings.current: A space roughly thirty zhang across, presumably the center of the cave.
findings.defect: The source gives a radius of roughly thirty zhang, while “thirty zhang across” makes that the diameter and halves the stated dimensions.
findings.replacement: A space roughly thirty *zhang* in radius, presumably the center of the cave.
findings.source: 동굴의 중심부로 추정되는 반경 삼십여 장의 공간.

findings.current: I should never have been so presumptuous in my certainty.
findings.defect: The draft introduces presumptuousness or arrogance; the source says his certainty was premature.
findings.rationale: 섣부른 describes a hasty or premature conclusion, not an inherently arrogant one.
findings.replacement: I should never have been so quick to assume.

summary: One critical quantity error, one meaningful presence-detection error, and several localized fidelity or natural-English defects.
